text:
mina: quick design sync on the invite flow stepper + SSO copy + audit-log nav hints. want a final pass before we ship the role-invite alpha. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/GHI/invite-stepper-v2 (frames: StepperCompact, SSO_CopyVariants, AuditNavHints)
alex: main debate: keep multi-step full-screen flow vs compact inline stepper inside modal. PM leans inline to reduce clicks.
frontend-junior: inline is easier to implement and keeps context, but edge-case: keyboard users might not realize it's multi-step if we hide progress. need clear aria.
mina: proposal: inline modal with a visible stepper bar (Step 1: Add emails, Step 2: Roles & SSO, Step 3: Review). show "Step x of 3" as live text for screen readers.
sam-a11y: yes — ensure step announcements with `role=region aria-live="polite"` and each step has `aria-labelledby` so screen readers land users on the current step. also ensure the Next button is disabled but focusable when validation fails (use `aria-disabled="true"`).
frontend-junior: good call. implementation note: we'll add `aria-live` container and toggle `aria-hidden` on non-active steps. also keyboard: support ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to move steps when focus is on the stepper controls, but only if the modal has focus.
mina: SSO copy — product provided two microcopy variants. want succinct and clear for admins. options: 
A) Control: "Require SSO" helper: "New invites must sign in through your org's SSO; existing members unchanged."
B) Control: "Enforce SSO" helper: "Invited users will be required to complete SSO when they join."
C) Control: "Require SSO for invites" helper: "Blocks invites from non-SSO signups."
alex: prefer A for clarity. C sounds aggressive and might worry customers.
sam-a11y: microcopy accessibility: include explicit consequence line for admins toggling the switch, e.g., "This will not affect current members." screen readers parse shorter sentences better. and ensure the switch uses `role=switch` and `aria-checked` updated on toggle.
mina: agreed. i'll lock A and add the short consequence line under the control. will also surface a small info link "How SSO affects invites" to docs.
frontend-junior: visual/a11y nit on the stepper: current active step uses a 2px underline in brand blue but text is 12px; contrast fails. suggest bolding the label + adding a 3px outline for keyboard focus.
sam-a11y: also avoid using color alone to indicate required fields inside step 2 (roles & SSO). add an icon or text label "required" and ensure error text uses 4.5:1 contrast.
mina: audit-log nav hint idea: when users land on audit log from org settings, show a subtle toast: "Tip: press g then f to jump to filters" — opt-in via a setting. Thoughts?
alex: love it. but make sure the key combo is documented and can be disabled. tooltips should not trap focus.
frontend-junior: tech note: we'll implement with a small key handler lib and gate via feature flag `inviteStepperKeys`. also implement first-run tooltip that can be dismissed and won't reappear.
sam-a11y: keyboard shortcut conflicts: gotta check VoiceOver Command keys on mac and NVDA. Only enable shortcuts for non-screen reader sessions or require user enablement in Keyboard Shortcuts settings.
mina: sounds right. i'll add a checkbox in Keyboard Shortcuts area: "Enable quick navigation for audit log". default off for safety.
deploy-bot: preview-deploy: invite-stepper-a11y branch deployed to staging at 2025-07-01T15:04:12Z :rocket:
mina: next steps: I'll update figma with locked microcopy + stepper visuals. Alex, can you review the disabled-but-focusable button pattern? frontend-junior will land the aria-live region and keyboard guidance. Sam to run a11y checks on staging once merged. leaving thread open for staging notes. :thumbsup:
